title: Capability observation
description: One thing actually seen. Learner evidence stays outside canonical curriculum content. A result may describe what happened, while help/error fields preserve whether the learner was independent and where the first meaningful failure occurred.

capability_ref.description: The one capability this observation is about.

question_ref.description: Optional worksheet/canonical question identifier that produced the observation. It is descriptive learner evidence, not source custody.

session_ref.description: Optional study/session identifier used to group observations from one sitting.

method.description: How it was observed -- which task was set, under what conditions.

observed.description: What the learner actually did or produced.

when.description: ISO date or timestamp. Lexically later ISO values are treated as newer evidence.

independence.description: Human-readable note about whether the learner had help. Seeing a worked solution is not evidence of independent mastery.

help.description: Small structured record of assistance used during this observation.

error_stage.description: First meaningful failure stage when one can be identified without guessing.
